rules.desc: Ensure <area> elements of image maps have alternative text
rules.help: Active <area> elements must have alternative text

rules.desc: Ensure an element's role supports its ARIA attributes
rules.help: Elements must only use supported ARIA attributes

rules.desc: Ensure aria-braillelabel and aria-brailleroledescription have a non-braille equivalent
rules.help: aria-braille attributes must have a non-braille equivalent

rules.desc: Ensure every ARIA button, link and menuitem has an accessible name
rules.help: ARIA commands must have an accessible name

rules.desc: Ensure ARIA attributes are used as described in the specification of the element's role
rules.help: ARIA attributes must be used as specified for the element's role

rules.desc: Ensure elements do not use deprecated roles
rules.help: Deprecated ARIA roles must not be used

rules.desc: Ensure aria-hidden="true" is not present on the document body.
rules.help: aria-hidden="true" must not be present on the document body

rules.desc: Ensure aria-hidden elements are not focusable nor contain focusable elements
rules.help: ARIA hidden element must not be focusable or contain focusable elements

rules.desc: Ensure every ARIA input field has an accessible name
rules.help: ARIA input fields must have an accessible name

rules.desc: Ensure every ARIA meter node has an accessible name
rules.help: ARIA meter nodes must have an accessible name

rules.desc: Ensure every ARIA progressbar node has an accessible name
rules.help: ARIA progressbar nodes must have an accessible name

rules.desc: Ensure ARIA attributes are not prohibited for an element's role
rules.help: Elements must only use permitted ARIA attributes

rules.desc: Ensure elements with ARIA roles have all required ARIA attributes
rules.help: Required ARIA attributes must be provided

rules.desc: Ensure elements with an ARIA role that require child roles contain them
rules.help: Certain ARIA roles must contain particular children

rules.desc: Ensure elements with an ARIA role that require parent roles are contained by them
rules.help: Certain ARIA roles must be contained by particular parents

rules.desc: Ensure aria-roledescription is only used on elements with an implicit or explicit role
rules.help: aria-roledescription must be on elements with a semantic role

rules.desc: Ensure all elements with a role attribute use a valid value
rules.help: ARIA roles used must conform to valid values

rules.desc: Ensure every ARIA tab node has an accessible name
rules.help: ARIA tab nodes must have an accessible name

rules.desc: Ensure every ARIA toggle field has an accessible name
rules.help: ARIA toggle fields must have an accessible name

rules.desc: Ensure every ARIA tooltip node has an accessible name
rules.help: ARIA tooltip nodes must have an accessible name

rules.desc: Ensure all ARIA attributes have valid values

rules.desc: Ensure attributes that begin with aria- are valid ARIA attributes
rules.help: ARIA attributes must conform to valid names

rules.desc: Ensure <audio> elements have captions

rules.desc: Ensure the autocomplete attribute is correct and suitable for the form field
rules.help: autocomplete attribute must be used correctly

rules.desc: Ensure that text spacing set through style attributes can be adjusted with custom stylesheets
rules.help: Inline text spacing must be adjustable with custom stylesheets

rules.desc: Ensure <blink> elements are not used
rules.help: <blink> elements are deprecated and must not be used

rules.desc: Ensure buttons have discernible text
rules.help: Buttons must have discernible text

rules.desc: Ensure each page has at least one mechanism for a user to bypass navigation and jump straight to the content
rules.help: Page must have means to bypass repeated blocks

rules.desc: Ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA minimum contrast ratio thresholds
rules.help: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds

rules.desc: Ensure content is not locked to any specific display orientation, and the content is operable in all display orientations
rules.help: CSS Media queries must not lock display orientation

rules.desc: Ensure <dl> elements are structured correctly
rules.help: <dl> elements must only directly contain properly-ordered <dt> and <dd> groups, <script>, <template> or <div> elements

rules.desc: Ensure <dt> and <dd> elements are contained by a <dl>
rules.help: <dt> and <dd> elements must be contained by a <dl>

rules.desc: Ensure each HTML document contains a non-empty <title> element
rules.help: Documents must have <title> element to aid in navigation

rules.desc: Ensure every id attribute value used in ARIA and in labels is unique
rules.help: IDs used in ARIA and labels must be unique

rules.desc: Ensure form field does not have multiple label elements
rules.help: Form field must not have multiple label elements

rules.desc: Ensure <frame> and <iframe> elements with focusable content do not have tabindex=-1
rules.help: Frames with focusable content must not have tabindex=-1

rules.desc: Ensure <iframe> and <frame> elements contain a unique title attribute
rules.help: Frames must have a unique title attribute

rules.desc: Ensure <iframe> and <frame> elements have an accessible name
rules.help: Frames must have an accessible name

rules.desc: Ensure every HTML document has a lang attribute
rules.help: <html> element must have a lang attribute

rules.desc: Ensure the lang attribute of the <html> element has a valid value
rules.help: <html> element must have a valid value for the lang attribute

rules.desc: Ensure that HTML elements with both valid lang and xml:lang attributes agree on the base language of the page
rules.help: HTML elements with lang and xml:lang must have the same base language

rules.desc: Ensure elements have alternative text or a role of none or presentation
rules.help: Images must have alternative text

rules.desc: Ensure input buttons have discernible text
rules.help: Input buttons must have discernible text

rules.desc: Ensure <input type="image"> elements have alternative text
rules.help: Image buttons must have alternative text

rules.desc: Ensure that elements labelled through their content must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
rules.help: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name

rules.desc: Ensure every form element has a label
rules.help: Form elements must have labels

rules.desc: Ensure links are distinguished from surrounding text in a way that does not rely on color
rules.help: Links must be distinguishable without relying on color

rules.desc: Ensure links have discernible text
rules.help: Links must have discernible text

rules.desc: Ensure that lists are structured correctly
rules.help: <ul> and <ol> must only directly contain <li>, <script> or <template> elements

rules.desc: Ensure <li> elements are used semantically
rules.help: <li> elements must be contained in a <ul> or <ol>

rules.desc: Ensure <marquee> elements are not used
rules.help: <marquee> elements are deprecated and must not be used

rules.desc: Ensure <meta http-equiv="refresh"> is not used for delayed refresh
rules.help: Delayed refresh under 20 hours must not be used

rules.desc: Ensure <meta name="viewport"> does not disable text scaling and zooming
rules.help: Zooming and scaling must not be disabled

rules.desc: Ensure interactive controls are not nested as they are not always announced by screen readers or can cause focus problems for assistive technologies
rules.help: Interactive controls must not be nested

rules.desc: Ensure <video> or <audio> elements do not autoplay audio for more than 3 seconds without a control mechanism to stop or mute the audio
rules.help: <video> or <audio> elements must not play automatically

rules.desc: Ensure <object> elements have alternative text
rules.help: <object> elements must have alternative text

Ensure bold, italic text and font-size is not used to style

elements as a heading
rules.help:
Styled

elements must not be used as headings

rules.desc: Ensure [role="img"] and [role="image"] elements have alternative text
rules.help: [role="img"] and [role="image"] elements must have alternative text

rules.desc: Ensure elements that have scrollable content are accessible by keyboard in Safari
rules.help: Scrollable region must have keyboard access

rules.desc: Ensure select element has an accessible name
rules.help: Select element must have an accessible name

rules.desc: Ensure that server-side image maps are not used
rules.help: Server-side image maps must not be used

rules.desc: Ensure summary elements have discernible text
rules.help: Summary elements must have discernible text

rules.desc: Ensure <svg> elements with an img, image, graphics-document or graphics-symbol role have accessible text
rules.help: <svg> elements with an img or image role must have alternative text

rules.desc: Ensure that tables with a caption use the <caption> element.
rules.help: Data or header cells must not be used to give caption to a data table.

rules.desc: Ensure touch targets have sufficient size and space
rules.help: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space

rules.desc: Ensure that each non-empty data cell in a <table> larger than 3 by 3  has one or more table headers
rules.help: Non-empty <td> elements in larger <table> must have an associated table header

rules.desc: Ensure that each cell in a table that uses the headers attribute refers only to other <th> elements in that table
rules.help: Table cell headers attributes must refer to other <th> elements in the same table

rules.desc: Ensure that <th> elements and elements with role=columnheader/rowheader have data cells they describe
rules.help: Table headers in a data table must refer to data cells

rules.desc: Ensure lang attributes have valid values
rules.help: lang attribute must have a valid value

rules.desc: Ensure <video> elements have captions
